boundaries: Axial, shear, bending and buckling statics only; dynamics, vibration, fatigue and seismic response are excluded.
Material strengths and moduli (yield, E, G) are supplied inputs with stated grade and standard, never looked up or assumed.
Forms needing roots (radius of gyration, section modulus inversion) must be recorded in squared honest-algebra form or deferred with sources, never approximated.
Expressions must be written in canonical base units of the runtime registry; never inline a conversion factor that belongs to unit scales (see the canonical-units rule).
Real-design claims (code compliance, safety certification) are excluded; records are algebraic forms with stated scope.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent source chapters/subtopics inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
integration_expectation: New meanings (axial_stress, axial_strain, axial_deformation, bending_deflection, critical_buckling_load and similar) and units (Pa, kPa, MPa, GPa) require extension; all seed forms are scalar with integer powers and fit the engine once meanings exist.
mission: Curate atomic reusable algebraic structural-statics relationships: stress, strain, deformation, beam deflection and column buckling, each with explicit geometry, supports and material-grade scope. Statics arithmetic only; continue through successive batches with no inference chain required.
priorities: Axial normal stress from force and cross-sectional area
Axial deformation from force, length, area and elastic modulus
Simply-supported beam midpoint deflection under a center point load
Euler critical buckling load for a declared effective-length case
special_checks: State support conditions (pinned, fixed, free) and effective-length factor in every buckling/deflection record
Guard positive area, length, modulus and second moment; retain tension/compression signs, never absolutize silently
Keep pi as an explicit literal with stated precision; record which value the oracle used
Distinguish elastic deformation from failure prediction in assumptions and permitted use
starter_sources: https://openstax.org -- navigate to a University Physics or statics/mechanics-of-materials title and its chapters on stress, strain and elasticity; record exact book, edition and section, never cite the root as evidence
No further source URLs were preverified for this assignment; discovery snippets alone do not prove the equation
